# PrivacySafe Downloads

Official software download host for PrivacySafe:
https://download.privacysafe.app/

PrivacySafe is Free/Libre and Open Source Software (FLOSS) for private communication and
storage. PrivacySafe builds are published by Ivy Cyber LLC. Upstream development,
education, standards, and public-interest research are funded by donations to
PrivacySafe Foundation, Inc., a 501(c)(3) nonprofit public charity. The
download.privacysafe.app site is hosted in Canada by 3NSoft, Inc. for Ivy Cyber LLC.
PrivacySafe provides encrypted chat, peer-to-peer voice and video calls, and encrypted
storage. No phone number is required to sign up.

## Download channels

- `latest`: current stable/recommended builds.
- `test`: pre-release testing builds.
- `nightly`: frequently updated development builds.

## Platforms and architecture names

- Windows `.exe`: `x64`, `arm64`. When only one architecture is published, the
  clean JavaScript shortcut may omit architecture.
- Android `.apk`: `x86_64`, `armeabi-v7a`, `arm64-v8a`. When only one architecture
  is published, the clean JavaScript shortcut may omit architecture.
- Mac OS `.dmg`: `x86_64`, `arm64`; the user-facing labels are `newer M Series` for arm64 and `older Intel` for x86_64.
- GNU/Linux AppImage: `x86_64`, `aarch64`.
- Debian packages: `amd64`, `arm64`.

Directory pages generate bold quick-download links from the newest matching
versioned installer in the directory. Existing alias-named files or symlinks do
not control the generated row: the raw alias entry is suppressed and the shortcut
is regenerated from the newest versioned installer. The generated row uses the
selected file's real date and file size and points directly to that versioned file
while suggesting a clean channel-based filename with the HTML `download` attribute.
When a directory publishes `checksums.json`, the corresponding SHA-256 value is
displayed beneath each Quick download when it can be matched to the selected build.
